title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the essential streets and corridors immediately surrounding the ASU Tempe campus, from the high-energy retail of Mill Avenue to the student-centric hubs along Apache Boulevard.

cards.title: The Historic Retail Hub
cards.subtitle: Mill Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Walk this historic stretch for a mix of local boutiques, national retailers, and diverse dining options located just steps from the campus's western edge.
cards.short_summary: A vibrant commercial corridor featuring historic architecture and a high density of student-oriented shops and restaurants.
cards.evidence_claim: Mill Avenue is recognized as the central hub for Tempe shopping, dining, and recreation, built around Arizona State University.
cards.source_title: Retail Space Available | Invest - Downtown Tempe
cards.access_notes: Public street with 24/7 pedestrian access; business hours vary by establishment.

cards.title: The Modern Campus Connector
cards.subtitle: College Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Visit this multi-modal streetscape north of University Drive to find the Sun Devil Marketplace and flexible public plaza spaces for community events.
cards.short_summary: A transformed urban block featuring the Sun Devil Marketplace and sustainable academic facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: College Avenue Commons is a mixed-use facility on College Avenue one block north of University Drive, housing the Sun Devil Marketplace.
cards.source_title: Paul C. Helmick Center - ASU Business and Finance
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; marketplace typically open daily during standard retail hours.

cards.title: The Residential Gateway
cards.subtitle: Apache Boulevard Corridor
cards.notes: Explore this corridor on the south side of campus, home to major student housing complexes and convenient on-site retail like Shibam Coffee.
cards.short_summary: A high-density residential and retail corridor serving students on the southern edge of the Tempe campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The District on Apache is located within walking distance of the ASU campus and features onsite retail like Shibam Coffee.
cards.access_notes: Public sidewalks and retail spaces; residential areas require keycard access.

cards.title: The Northern Perimeter
cards.subtitle: University Drive Corridor
cards.notes: Walk along this major thoroughfare to access off-campus apartments and quick-service dining options just north of the main academic buildings.
cards.short_summary: A primary east-west corridor bordering the northern edge of campus with numerous student housing options.
cards.evidence_claim: Paseo on University offers student lifestyle housing near ASU, located along the University Drive corridor.
cards.source_title: Paseo on University - ASU Off-Campus Student Housing
cards.access_notes: Public thoroughfare; retail and housing access varies.

cards.title: The Modern Living Block
cards.subtitle: Terrace Road Corridor
cards.notes: Check out this emerging block featuring new high-rise student communities like VERVE Tempe and Vertex Apartments near the light rail.
cards.short_summary: A concentrated block of modern student housing developments located southeast of the main campus.
cards.evidence_claim: VERVE Tempe is a 15-story student housing community located at 1047 S Terrace Rd, steps from ASU.
cards.source_title: VERVE Tempe Student Living Community | Subtext
cards.access_notes: Public street access; residential amenities for residents only.

cards.title: The West Campus Edge
cards.subtitle: Forest Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Stop by this street for local favorites like Harry's Coffee Shop, providing a quieter alternative to the main Mill Avenue bustle.
cards.short_summary: A street bordering the western campus edge known for its local dining and student-friendly atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Harry's Coffee Shop is located at 715 S Forest Ave, serving as a classic diner for the ASU community.

cards.title: The Eastern Transit Link
cards.subtitle: Rural Road Corridor
cards.notes: Use this major north-south corridor to access the University Drive/Rural Road light rail station and eastern campus housing like Sonora Center.
cards.short_summary: A primary transportation artery on the eastern edge of campus connecting students to the light rail and housing.
cards.evidence_claim: Sonora Center is located at 1480 S. Rural Rd, providing housing for first-year students on the south side of campus.
cards.access_notes: Public thoroughfare; light rail station accessible 24/7.

cards.title: The Historic Neighborhood
cards.subtitle: Ash Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Walk through this quiet residential street to see historic bungalows and mature trees in one of Tempe's most walkable off-campus neighborhoods.
cards.short_summary: A historic residential district west of Mill Avenue offering a quieter, pedestrian-friendly environment.
cards.evidence_claim: The Residences on Ash are situated on the quiet residential Ash Avenue within walking distance to downtown Tempe and ASU.
cards.source_title: The Residences on Ash - 1209 S Ash Ave Tempe AZ
cards.access_notes: Public residential street; please respect resident privacy.

cards.title: The Stadium Gateway
cards.subtitle: 5th Street Corridor
cards.notes: Explore the retail spaces near the Veterans Way light rail station, serving as a primary path for fans heading to Mountain America Stadium.
cards.short_summary: A retail-heavy block near the light rail station and athletic facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: 200 East Fifth Street offers retail space near the Veterans Way light rail station and ASU stadium.

cards.title: The Waterfront District
cards.subtitle: Rio Salado Parkway Corridor
cards.notes: Walk north to the lakefront for scenic paths and major events at Tempe Beach Park, located just north of the campus core.
cards.short_summary: A scenic waterfront corridor offering recreational paths and event spaces north of the university.
cards.evidence_claim: Tempe Town Lake is a man-made oasis with paths for jogging and free events, located near the ASU campus.
cards.source_title: Tempe Town Lake | City of Tempe, AZ
cards.access_notes: Park paths open daily from 5:00 AM to 12:00 AM.
